jobs.occupation: Salad Production Worker/ Cold Storage Environment
jobs.description:
Location: Purmerend, Netherlands
Working Conditions: Cold storage at 8°C
Job Description:
We are seeking dedicated and motivated individuals to work in our salad production facility.
This role involves working in a chilled environment, ensuring the preparation and packaging of fresh, high-quality salads.
Main Responsibilities:
- Preparing, packaging, and conducting quality checks on salad products.
- Operating production machinery (training provided).
- Maintaining cleanliness and order in the workplace.
- Following all hygiene and safety protocols.
Requirements:
- Basic communication skills in English are required.
- Availability for a minimum of 6 months, with potential for vacation during the contract.
- Willingness to work flexible shifts depending on production needs.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Working Hours:
Day Shifts:
- From 8:30 to 17:00 or 7:00 to 15:00.
Night/Evening Shifts:
- Start at 18:00 and finish upon task completion, depending on the volume of orders (typically between 2:00 and 4:00).
Additional Compensation:
- Overtime (above 40 hours): 125% pay rate.
- Sundays and Public Holidays: 200% pay rate.
Night Shifts:
- From 19:00 to 23:00 – 125% pay rate.
- From 23:00 to 06:00 – 140% pay rate.
- Sundays starting at 23:00 – 140% pay rate.
What We Offer:
A competitive base hourly wage, with bonuses for evening, night, and holiday shifts.
Vacation pay (8% of gross annual salary) and paid vacation days in line with Dutch labor law.
A supportive and diverse team environment.
Opportunities for training and professional development.
Assistance with housing and transportation if necessary.
If you are ready, apply today and become part of our team!
